scientific_integrity: Eigenvalue crossings are proved analytically; numerical checker supplements but is not a substitute for proof; originality remains conditional on accessible historical literature.
scientific_limitations: Complete linear spectral classification only for integer gamma/Erlang orders 1–6, positive feedback a>b>0, finite positive mean delay; no nonlinear Hopf criticality, global attraction, higher-order classification, or finite-population validation.
title: The fifth Erlang stage is the first to restore stability in a delayed neuronal center
